subject: Procurement portal governance refresh + capacity increase for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Jack Lee <jack.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement portal refresh: renewal & capacity increase

Hi Sean,

We're starting our renewal planning and want to both extend our contract and increase committed capacity for Q1. Procurement is asking that we do a vendor onboarding refresh through our procurement portal (SOC 2 evidence, updated contact list, and a new PO). Can you share your procurement checklist and confirm if Redwood supports onboarding via our Ariba-style portal (we use a SSO + vendor portal integration)?

Also can you provide a proposed mutual action plan with dates — procurement wants to close by Nov 30 to hit Q1 budget approval.

Thanks,
Jack
Jack Lee
Head of IT Procurement
Acme Analytics

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jack Lee <jack.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement portal refresh: renewal & capacity increase

Jack — thanks for the ping.

We're happy to run the onboarding refresh and support your portal. Attached is our standard procurement checklist (Procurement_Checklist_202611.pdf) which lists required evidence (SOC2 report, DPA, contact matrix), PO formatting, and onboarding steps for SSO/vendor-portal integrations. Quick notes:
- We can accept PO via your portal or by email with a signed SOW amendment.
- For capacity increases, we'll provide a short pricing schedule once you confirm target token throughput and concurrency targets.
- Typical timeline for a portal-based onboarding + signature: 2–3 weeks once we have PO and SOC2 evidence.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) 10/21 — Redwood sends checklist + draft SOW amendment (attached).
2) 10/25 — Acme confirms PO timing and target capacity.
3) 11/01 — Legal redlines returned; pricing finalized.
4) 11/15 — PO received; onboarding scheduled.
5) 11/30 — Contract effective; capacity increase in prod.

If that timeline looks tight for you, tell us the date constraints and we can prioritize Legal/Procurement touchpoints.

Attaching: Procurement_Checklist_202611.pdf (attachment)

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Priya Singh <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement portal refresh: renewal & capacity increase

Sean / team —

Thanks for the checklist. A few formal items from Acme Procurement:
- Please complete our vendor onboarding form in the portal (link to follow).
- We need a signed SOW amendment for the capacity increase and updated MSA terms for the next 24 months.
- Please provide a PO template we can populate; PO must include our standard indemnity clause and the billing cadence (monthly).
- Target dates: Procurement requests final contract by 11/22 to meet finance cutoffs.

I'll share the portal invite (vendor_portal@acme-analytics) and the PO template in a separate email. If Redwood has standard redlines you cannot accept, call them out now so we can identify deal blockers.

Regards,
Priya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <procurement@acme-analytics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T11:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement portal refresh: renewal & capacity increase

Priya / Priya's team —

Laura here from Redwood Legal. Apologies for the brief delay; we've reviewed the requested term changes. Summary of our position:
- Term: Redwood can accommodate a 24-month term, we will propose a 2-year SOW amendment (attached: RWI_SOW_amendment_v1.pdf).
- Indemnity: We can accept a reciprocal indemnity with caps — redlines attached.
- Data security: SOC2 report will be provided upon receipt of the vendor portal NDA; we will upload a redacted SOC2 and the DPA.
- Billing: Monthly invoicing is acceptable; please confirm PO number format so Finance can map invoices.

Attached: RWI_SOW_amendment_v1.pdf (attachment), Redline_Summary.docx (attachment).

Two asks to keep timeline: please confirm by 11/13 if the SOW amendment is acceptable; we aim to sign and process the PO week of 11/15. If Acme needs additional concessions, list them specifically so we can escalate.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jack Lee <jack.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Priya Singh <procurement@acme-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Arun Patel <arun.patel@vendorportal.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:23:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Procurement portal governance refresh + capacity increase for Acme Analytics

Team — quick status update and next steps:

1) Acme has approved the SOW amendment as drafted by Redwood Legal. Laura — thanks for the rapid turnaround.
2) We've received PO# RWI-ACME-5573 via the portal and Finance confirmed billing cadence is monthly.
3) SOC2 evidence uploaded to the portal (SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf) — Arun, please confirm access and that the document satisfies the portal requirements.
4) Proposed technical onboarding: 2026-11-20 10:00 PT (30–45m) — please confirm attendees. During that call we'll:
   - Validate SSO and vendor portal integration points,
   - Confirm capacity targets and activation windows,
   - Walk through billing & usage reporting in the Redwood Console.

Next steps for each owner:
- Acme Procurement (Priya): confirm portal access for Redwood and approve PO mapping to invoices.
- Acme IT (Jack): confirm attendees for the 11/20 technical onboarding.
- Redwood (Monica/Neha): prepare capacity pricing schedule and pre-provision the staging pool.
- Redwood Legal (Laura): await countersignature and upload final SOW.

Attachments: SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf (attachment)

Thanks everyone — on track for capacity activation by the end of November if onboarding goes as scheduled.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193
